address: First Floor, French Salon, Fenwick Northumberland Street, Newcastle upon Tyne,NE1 7AF
bio: Café 21 is a sociable and effortlessly stylish space, serving crafted comforts, lunch bites and sweet treats. Located in the heart of Newcastle, this is the perfect place to relax and enjoy an Afternoon Tea.  The chefs at Café 21 are great lovers of tradition, serving the legendary Viennese Sacher Torter alongside quintessentially British Afternoon Tea delights. Afternoon Tea is served daily from 2pm in the in-store eatery located on the First Floor of Fenwick, Northumberland Street, in the heart of Newcastle City Centre.  The menu includes a selection of traditional sandwiches, raisin and plain scones and an assortment of handmade pastries with the option to include Champagne Taittinger for a luxury Afternoon Tea experience.
